reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The proviion of a loan of up to US$ 25 million equivalent to Joint Stock Commercial Bank with Foreign Capital Hamkorbank (Hamkorbank) (MSME Loan III). The proceeds will be used to finance eligible MSMEs in accordance with the standard requirements set in the Policy Statement for the Financial Intermediary Framework (FIF). The MSME Loan III will enable Hamkorbank to maintain diversification of its funding base, extend duration of its liabilities and expand financing of MSMEs in Uzbekistan at a multiple of the EBRD financing.
